minors.issue: actions/setup-go runs with its default cache: true, so the tag build restores the Go module and build caches saved by main-branch ci.yml runs; the binaries that are attested and later signed can depend on cache contents that are not in the tagged source
minors.scenario: a main-branch CI run saves a GOCACHE or module cache entry with unexpected contents; the next vX.Y.Z tag run restores it, go build reuses the cached objects, and the attestation records a binary that a clean rebuild of the tag would not reproduce

minors.issue: the release build sets only -X main.version, while the Makefile also sets main.commit and main.date, so release binaries report commit and build date as unknown
minors.scenario: an operator runs `moonglass version` on an installed v1.2.3 binary and gets `commit unknown` and `built unknown`, so the binary cannot be traced to its source commit from its own output
